home.headline: Hardware that sits *inside* the wall.
home.sub: Flush plates, sockets, switches, paper holders and towel bars built into the surface instead of onto it. One recess depth, one finish family, no visible fixings.
home.heroImageCaption: Lifestyle shot — flush plate installed in a tiled wall

proofs.label: One standard recess depth across every system
Finishes, matched across plates, sockets and holders
Drawings and installation sheets per article
Certified components, tested to EU standard
Fast dispatch from our Tirana warehouse
Warranty on mechanical and electrical components

home.specTitle: Drawn for the installer, invisible to the client
home.specBody: Every article ships with a steel mounting box, a plaster-in frame and a DWG drawing. Recess depths are standardised at 45 mm so electrics, sanitary and joinery are coordinated once.
home.specImageCaption: Detail shot — recessed socket, flush with plaster

specPoints.text: Steel mounting box and plaster-in frame supplied with the article.
Tolerances allow 6–12 mm tile or 10 mm plaster build-up.
Electrical articles rated IP44 for zone 2 placement.
Finish samples sent free to trade accounts in Albania and Kosovo.

home.howIntro: Four systems, four sequences. Each article ships as a full kit — box, frame, fixings and drawing — so the wall is cut once.
home.ctaBannerBody: Message us on WhatsApp with what you need and receive article pricing, lead times and drawings within one working day.

flush-plates.name: Flush plates
flush-plates.blurb: Frameless actuator plates for concealed cisterns.

recessed-sockets.name: Recessed sockets
recessed-sockets.blurb: Power outlets that close level with the wall.

light-switches.name: Light switches
light-switches.blurb: Touch and rocker switches set into plaster.

paper-holders.name: Paper holders
paper-holders.blurb: Incasso holders with a soft-closing flap.

towel-systems.name: Towel systems
towel-systems.blurb: Bars and niches built into the wall face.

manifold-cabinets.name: Manifold cabinets
manifold-cabinets.blurb: Service access without a visible frame.

FP-01.name: Plate 01 Square
FP-01.description: A frameless dual-flush actuator that finishes level with the tile. The plate is cut from 3 mm stainless and set in a plaster-in frame, so the only visible line is the joint around the two touch fields.

FP-02.name: Plate 02 Round
FP-02.description: The round variant of the 01 plate, machined from a single piece with two concentric touch fields.

FP-03.name: Plate 03 Tileable
FP-03.description: A carrier plate that accepts the project tile, so the actuator disappears into the wall pattern entirely.

RS-01.name: Socket 01 Single
RS-01.description: A single outlet on a spring-loaded lid that closes flush with the wall when not in use. Rated IP44 for zone 2 placement.

RS-02.name: Socket 02 Double
RS-02.description: Two outlets behind one flush lid, sharing a single mounting box.

RS-03.name: Socket 03 USB-C
RS-03.description: Charging only, for mirror cabinets and vanity recesses.

LS-01.name: Switch 01 Touch
LS-01.description: A capacitive field flush with the plaster, marked only by a machined hairline.

LS-02.name: Switch 02 Rocker
LS-02.description: A mechanical rocker recessed behind a flush bezel.

LS-03.name: Switch 03 Dimmer
LS-03.description: Rotary dimmer with the knob set below the wall face.

PH-01.name: Holder 01 Flap
PH-01.description: A recessed paper holder with a soft-closing flap that sits level with the wall. The roll loads from the front and the flap doubles as a shelf when open.

PH-02.name: Holder 02 Open
PH-02.description: An open niche version without a flap, sized for the spare roll.

TS-01.name: Towel 01 Bar
TS-01.description: A bar set into a shallow niche so towels hang against the wall plane rather than off it.

TS-02.name: Towel 02 Niche
TS-02.description: A full-height niche with a concealed bar at the head, for stacked and hanging towels together.

MC-01.name: Cabinet 01 Manifold
MC-01.description: A push-to-open service door with no visible frame, giving access to the manifold behind a tiled or plastered face.

MC-02.name: Cabinet 02 Tall
MC-02.description: The tall variant for vertical manifolds and filter sets.

how-flush.title: Hidden flush plate
how-flush.text: The opening is cut by hand or water jet, then the frame is plastered in level with the tile. The actuator clips to the frame last, after grouting, so the finished wall shows only the joint line. Fits the cistern brands listed on each article.

how-electro.title: Invisible sockets and switches
how-electro.text: Both mount into a standard 60 mm box, so existing rough-in usually needs no change. The lid closes flush and the article is rated IP44 for zone 2. Suitable for new build and for retrofit into a finished wall.

how-holders.title: Recessed paper and towel holders
how-holders.text: A steel box is set into the wall build-up and the front frame is plastered or tiled up to. The visible part is only the flap or bar, sitting level with the wall face.

how-cabinet.title: Manifold access cabinet
how-cabinet.text: The carcass is fixed into the partition and the door is faced with the project tile, so access stays available without a visible frame. Push-to-open, no handle.
